methodology.browserMode: Installed browser channel in Playwright headless mode; the reported WebGL renderer identifies the actual GPU path
methodology.cacheStates: Run 1 uses the fresh Playwright browser context HTTP cache (cold); runs 2-3 reload in the same context (warm). The preview server and operating-system file cache may already be warm.
methodology.summaryStatistic: Median of three per-run values, except minimumFullExplosionFps is the minimum observed across all three runs
methodology.initialLoadDefinition: Navigation start until both preload modules report ready
methodology.allModulesLoadDefinition: Load-all activation until all eight modules report ready
methodology.orbitDefinition: Median requestAnimationFrame FPS during an active primary-button orbit, gated to frames no more than 100 ms after the latest pointer move; 180 pointer moves use a 10 ms minimum pacing delay across the measured interval, actual input duration is recorded, and post-input stationary frames are excluded
methodology.fullExplosionDefinition: Minimum requestAnimationFrame FPS while advancing the full-explosion slider across 90 frames

regressionFloors.rationale: Hardware-tolerant hard floors catch severe regressions; 45 FPS remains a soft quality target rather than a universal pass criterion

methodology.textureBytesDefinition: Sum of unique decoded texture width x height x 4 bytes in loaded module materials
